MY STORY

A decade in real estate — now in your corner.

Hi, I'm Letina — REALTOR® & Certified Property Manager (CPM®), and real estate has been my world for over ten years.

Before helping families buy and sell here in North Texas, I spent 10+ years on the commercial side of the industry — overseeing more than 20 million square feet of Class A industrial real estate, plus lease administration, capital planning, and real estate finance. I've read the contracts, run the numbers, and managed the deals most people never see.

Now I bring all of that to the people who matter most: you. First home, forever home, an investment, or selling to start a new chapter — you get an agent who genuinely understands value, negotiation, and how to protect your biggest investment. Not just a friendly face (though you get that too).

I'm proud to call North Texas home, and I'd be honored to help you make your next big move here.
